source.title: Qualify DM leads with AI and book calls
source.original_goal: Qualify DM leads with AI and book calls
source.demand_evidence: Catalogue presence only; popularity and conversion are unmeasured.

goal: Qualify an inbound DM enquiry with two questions and provide a booking link or handoff.

keyword.description: Exact comment or inbound DM campaign word, at most 50 characters.

question_one.description: First approved question; no diagnosis or guaranteed outcome.

question_two.description: Second approved question, asked only after an actual first answer.

qualification_policy.description: Approved appropriate, inappropriate and unclear enquiry criteria.

booking_url.description: Coach-supplied booking url, preserved without invented claims.

language.description: Coach's message language; provide the exact approved copy in this language.

initial_text.description: Exact complete coach-approved initial text in language, within this recipe's unchanged promise and transitions.

refusal_text.description: Exact complete coach-approved refusal text in language, within this recipe's unchanged promise and transitions.

handoff_text.description: Exact complete coach-approved handoff text in language, within this recipe's unchanged promise and transitions.

next_step.description: Choose team handoff or an existing booking destination. Neither confirms an appointment.

messages.initial: Would you like to answer two questions about your situation?
messages.continuation: After new explicit affirmative consent matching the presented opt-in, ask question_one. After its actual answer, ask question_two and wait for a distinct actual answer. Use qualification_policy without inventing answers. Use the approved next_step; handoff needs no calendar or URL. Clarify ambiguous campaign context.
messages.refusal: Understood. I will not continue this campaign. You can ask our team for help.
messages.handoff: Our team will handle your request.

transitions.event: Coach supplies approved business facts and selects the existing account.
transitions.action: Prepare exact messages and native payloads locally; obtain scoped approvals and save private intent.
transitions.evidence: Preview, recipe digest and private card readback.

transitions.event: The contact sends the campaign word in an ordinary Instagram DM.
transitions.action: Provide the real entry event; an external click is not a reply.
transitions.evidence: Actual account, recipient, media/word and entry event IDs.

transitions.event: The approved native automation receives that entry.
transitions.action: Send exactly one initial message containing the approved value or question.
transitions.evidence: Recipient-side first message and linked source.

transitions.event: The contact actually replies within the permitted window.
transitions.action: After new explicit affirmative consent matching the presented opt-in, ask question_one and question_two separately, waiting for each actual answer. Use qualification_policy and the approved next_step without inventing answers. Clarify ambiguous campaign context.
transitions.evidence: Actual answers and the agreed next step are visible in the correct campaign conversation.

transitions.event: The contact opens the supplied external destination.
transitions.action: Handle any actual booking, registration, join or purchase outside this skill.
transitions.evidence: An external confirmation is required before claiming that external result.

outcome: Actual answers and the agreed next step are visible in the correct campaign conversation.
negative_cases: Unrelated general support must not become this campaign's lead.

resume.action: Restore the private card, confirm this recipe digest and account, then read current owned and shared settings. Reconcile unknown results without retry.
resume.campaign_match: Require an actual unambiguous campaign-word inbound event and the same recipient's linked answers.

stop.action: Disable only the campaign-owned comment rule, if present. Remove only campaign additions from shared DM text, captures and handoff; retain other campaigns and support.
stop.proof: Read back changes. Test late entry, late DM, the second campaign and ordinary support before accepting complete stop.

two_actual_answers.description: Two actual inbound answers match the approved questions.

handoff_confirmed.description: The same recipient's actual request reaches confirmed team handoff after the two answers.

booking_link_received.description: The qualified recipient receives the approved existing booking link.

no_false_booking_confirmation.description: The conversation does not claim a booking or automatically hand off successful qualification.
